name: heartbeat
message: [heartbeat] Read agents/may/heartbeat.md and work through it. You have full authority to act — dispatch approved work, fix issues, don't wait for permission.
description: May's heartbeat — follow-up, system health, initiative (30min)

name: watchdog
message: [cron:watchdog] Check for stale sessions.
description: Cancel sessions stuck running > 30min (JS handler, 10min interval)

name: evaluate-sessions
message: [cron:evaluate-sessions] Evaluate unevaluated sessions.
description: Auto-evaluate completed sessions every 1h (JS handler)

name: system-status
message: [cron:system-status] Operational status check.
description: Operational status check every 4h (JS handler)

name: daily-brief
message: [cron:daily-brief] Generate daily system brief.
description: Daily system metrics summary (JS handler, 24h)

name: heartbeat-bob

description: Bob's mission heartbeat — design, todo drain, philosophy audit (30min)

name: heartbeat-optimizer
message: [heartbeat] You are Optimizer. Your files are in agents/optimizer/. Read agents/optimizer/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.
description: Optimizer's heartbeat — find highest-impact improvement (30min)

name: heartbeat-coach
message: [heartbeat] You are Coach. Your files are in agents/coach/. Read agents/coach/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.
description: Coach heartbeat — triage, coaching, long-term mission work (30min)

name: heartbeat-evaluator
message: [heartbeat] You are Evaluator. Your files are in agents/evaluator/. Read agents/evaluator/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.
description: Evaluator's heartbeat — review eval quality, calibrate (30min)

name: heartbeat-amy
message: [heartbeat] You are Amy. Your files are in agents/amy/. Read agents/amy/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.

name: heartbeat-scout

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Analyze the last 10 evaluations in .state/evaluations/. Identify the top recurring pattern. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md. Compare recent evaluations against previous ones — did targeted fixes help? If same issue persists, recommend a different approach.
description: Bob analyzes evaluation patterns daily (via run-agent-task)

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md and agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. Work on the top TODO item or top finding. Check for LLM-to-JS replacement opportunities. One fix per run.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day (via run-agent-task)

name: lesson-consolidation
message: [cron:lesson-consolidation] Read all agents/*/LESSONS.md files. Deduplicate, consolidate, remove stale entries. Preserve proven lessons.
description: Weekly LESSONS.md cleanup (via run-agent-task)

name: coaching-report
message: [cron:coaching-report] Generate daily coaching quality report.
description: Daily coaching quality report — per-agent scores, trends (JS handler, 24h)

name: focus-task-tracker
message: [cron:focus-task-tracker] Check active focus tasks for progress.
description: Track focus task progress — remind, check signals, escalate if stuck (JS handler, 1h)

name: focus-task-driver
message: [cron:focus-task-driver] Read agents/shared/focus-tasks.md. Pick the focus task most needing attention. Work on it — do actual work, not just docs. Keep iterating until resolved or blocked. Update focus-tasks.md with progress.
description: Bob drives focus tasks forward (via run-agent-task, 1h)

name: iraq-conflict-monitor
message: [cron:iraq-conflict-monitor] Search Reddit and news for latest Iraq conflict updates. Write brief to agents/shared/daily-briefs/iraq-conflict-latest.md. Fact vs emotion. Keep it short. If nothing new, say so and stop.
description: Hourly Iraq conflict brief — fact vs emotion (via run-agent-task)
